neighbours.label: ' to' right after 'allowed' (permission to do something)
fire: Visitors are not allowed to feed the animals at the zoo.
After the inspection, the restaurant was allowed to reopen on Monday.
Students will be allowed to bring one page of notes into the exam.
During the strike, nurses were still allowed to treat emergency cases.
My parents never allowed us to stay up past nine.
Players are allowed to substitute three times per match.
The prisoner was finally allowed to see his lawyer.
In this mode, users are allowed to edit the shared files.
quiet: Visitors walked over to the enclosure to watch the animals at the zoo.
After the inspection, the restaurant returned to normal business on Monday.
Students will listen to a short lecture before the exam.
During the strike, nurses still went to the ward for emergency cases.
My parents always read stories to us before nine.
Players pass the ball to each other three times per move.
The prisoner finally spoke to his lawyer.
In this mode, changes are sent to the shared files.

notes: All top 32 are ' to', nearly all after 'allowed' or 'capable'. Probe: 'allowed to' 0.79, 'permitted to' 0.17, 'able to' 0.22, 'contributions to' 0.00. The - pole is ' to' after nouns like 'contributions'/'adds' (to as a preposition of addition). Near misses keep ' to' in other roles.
